name: @innis/nostr-relay-selection
description: Deterministic outbox-model relay routing for Nostr: publish routing, read routing, author-set-cover, relay hints, NIP-65 inbox/outbox and NIP-17 DM-inbox list parsing. Pure functions, zero dependencies — a policy spec locked to a shared test corpus, not an engine.

tasks.check: deno check mod.ts src/ tests/ examples/
tasks.lint: deno lint --ignore=cov_profile/,src/normalise-url.ts,examples/ && deno lint --rules-exclude=innis/no-type-assertions src/normalise-url.ts && deno lint --rules-exclude=no-console examples/
tasks.coverage: rm -rf cov_profile && deno test -A --coverage=cov_profile && deno coverage cov_profile --lcov --output=cov_profile/lcov.info && deno coverage cov_profile && deno run --allow-read jsr:@innis/coding-standards@^0.2.3/check-coverage
tasks.ci: deno task fmt:check && deno task lint && deno task lint-exemptions && deno task check && deno task coverage && deno task exports-tested && deno task docs
